rules.message: You can only manage your own listings
rules.check: const me = await ctx.me('host'); return String(row.host_id) === String(me);
const a = String(row.check_in).slice(0,10); const b = String(row.check_out).slice(0,10); return b > a;

rules.message: Check-in can't be in the past
rules.check: const a = String(row.check_in).slice(0,10); return a >= ctx.now().toISOString().slice(0,10);

rules.message: That's more guests than this stay sleeps
rules.check: const res: any = await ctx.db.query('select max_guests, host_id from stay where id = $1', [row.stay_id]); const rows = Array.isArray(res) ? res : (res.rows || []); if (!rows.length) return 'Stay not found'; if (String(rows[0].host_id) !== String(row.host_id)) return 'Wrong host for this stay'; return Number(row.guests) >= 1 && Number(row.guests) <= Number(rows[0].max_guests);

const res: any = await ctx.db.query('select count(*)::int as n from booked_range where stay_id = $1 and active = true and check_in < $3::date and check_out > $2::date', [row.stay_id, String(row.check_in).slice(0,10), String(row.check_out).slice(0,10)]); const rows = Array.isArray(res) ? res : (res.rows || []); return Number(rows[0] ? rows[0].n : 0) === 0;

rules.message: You can review a stay once it has ended
rules.check: const res: any = await ctx.db.query('select guest_id, stay_id, status, check_out from booking where id = $1', [row.booking_id]); const rows = Array.isArray(res) ? res : (res.rows || []); if (!rows.length) return 'Booking not found'; const b = rows[0]; if (String(b.guest_id) !== String(row.guest_id) || String(b.stay_id) !== String(row.stay_id)) return 'This is not your booking'; const co = new Date(b.check_out).getTime(); if (!(b.status === 'completed' || co <= ctx.now().getTime())) return false; const d: any = await ctx.db.query('select count(*)::int as n from review where booking_id = $1', [row.booking_id]); const dr = Array.isArray(d) ? d : (d.rows || []); if (Number(dr[0] ? dr[0].n : 0) > 0) return 'You already reviewed this stay'; return Number(row.rating) >= 1 && Number(row.rating) <= 5;

stay.title: Alfama Terrace Loft
stay.summary: Sun-soaked loft above the rooftops of Alfama with a wraparound terrace, tiled floors and tram bells drifting up from the street. Wake to river views and walk to every fado bar.

stay.title: Cliffside Cave House
stay.summary: A whitewashed cave house carved into the caldera with a private plunge pool and sunsets that stop conversation. Cool stone, soft arches, endless blue.

stay.title: Machiya Garden House
stay.summary: A restored 100-year-old machiya with tatami rooms, a mossy courtyard garden and a deep cedar soaking tub. Five minutes from Gion on foot.

stay.title: Northern Lights Cottage
stay.summary: A red-roofed cottage on the edge of the lava fields with a geothermal hot tub, panoramic windows and a front-row seat to the aurora.

stay.title: Jungle Canopy Treehouse
stay.summary: Sleep among the treetops in a handcrafted treehouse with an open-air bathroom, hammocks and howler monkeys for an alarm clock. Cenotes are ten minutes by bike.

stay.title: Lemon Grove Villa
stay.summary: A pastel villa tumbling down the Amalfi cliffs with lemon terraces, a pergola dining table and a path straight to the sea. Eight beds, one unforgettable view.

stay.title: Pinecrest Lakeside Cabin
stay.summary: A timber cabin steps from the water with a wood-burning stove, a hot tub under the pines and a dock for morning coffee. Ski in winter, paddle in summer.

stay.title: Old Town Georgian Flat
stay.summary: High ceilings, sash windows and a wall of books on the Royal Mile's quiet side. Castle views from the kitchen table and a tiny pub on the corner.

stay.title: Riad Jasmin
stay.summary: A hidden riad with a zellige courtyard, a plunge pool and a rooftop terrace made for mint tea at sunset. Breakfast is served under the orange tree.

stay.title: Rice Terrace Bamboo Villa
stay.summary: A soaring bamboo villa above the Tegallalang rice terraces with an open-air living room, private pool and daily breakfast delivered by boat-shaped tray.
stay.amenities: Wifi,Private pool,Breakfast,Rice field view,Air conditioning,Yoga deck

do.code: await ctx.db.create('booked_range', { stay_id: row.stay_id, booking_id: row.id, check_in: row.check_in, check_out: row.check_out, active: true });

do.code: const all = await ctx.db.list('booked_range'); for (const r of all) { if (String(r.booking_id) === String(row.id)) { await ctx.db.update('booked_range', String(r.id), { active: false }); } }

workflows.title: Daily: complete bookings whose check-out has passed

do.code: const today = ctx.now().toISOString().slice(0,10); const all = await ctx.db.list('booking'); let n = 0; for (const b of all) { if (b.status === 'confirmed' && String(b.check_out).slice(0,10) < today) { await ctx.db.update('booking', String(b.id), { status: 'completed' }); n++; } } ctx.log('completed ' + n + ' bookings');
